events.verdict: Murray (DEN) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Middleton (MIL) makes marginal contact with Murray's (DEN) arm during the drive but it does not affect his SQBR.
Jokic (DEN) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Jokic (DEN) briefly grasps Lopez's (MIL) shoulder prior to the pick but it does not affect his ability to set the pick.
RLB shows Murray (DEN) is in a legal guarding position as Brogdon (MIL) initiates the marginal contact.
Jokic (DEN) engages with Lopez (MIL) but does not affect his FOM.
Millsap (DEN) puts a hand/forearm to Middleton's (MIL) front during his drive, but does not affect his SQBR.
LLB shows Jokic (DEN) makes contact with the ball on Antetokoumpo's (MIL) during his drive.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) engages against Millsap's (DEN) back during the screen but it does not affect his ability to defend.
Jokic (DEN) slightly extends his arm against Bledsoe's (MIL) back during the pick but it does not affect his ability to defend through the play.
Middleton (MIL) does not give Millsap (DEN) a step to avoid contact but it does not affect his ability to defend.
Middleton (MIL) engages with Hernangomez (DEN) in the post but doesn't affect his ability to defend the play.
Jokic (DEN) firms up in Brogdon's (MIL) path during the screen but it does not affect his ability to defend through the play.
Murray (DEN) slightly extends his arms into Brogdon (MIL)'s front during the screen but it does not affect his ability to defend.
[Observable in enhanced review] Hernangomez (DEN) shuffles his feet during the pump fake.
Jokic (DEN) makes contact with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm during the pass.
Hernangomez (DEN) makes contact with Bledose's (MIL) arm during his drive.

Lopez (MIL) makes contact with Millsap's (DEN) hand during the follow-through on his jump shot but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
